title: Crestline Fleet Account Terms Changes
content:
The terms of a Crestline Fleet Account change in two ways only.

**At the fleet manager's request:**
- the account's ticket approval limit may be set lower than (never above) the program's default ticket approval limit;
- the requirement of a purchase order on every ticket may be switched on or off;
- the billing cycle may move to another of the billing cycles the program offers, from the next month.

**At a credit review,** held every program review interval in months, Crestline Fleet Credit may raise the credit limit by up to the program's largest increase percent, never above the program's largest credit limit and within the combined credit limit rule, or lower it.

**Customer care never changes a credit limit itself.**

## Who may change what

| Term | Fleet manager's request | Crestline Fleet Credit at a credit review | Customer care on its own |
|---|---|---|---|
| ticket approval limit | lower only, never above the program default | — | — |
| purchase order on every ticket | switch | — | — |
| billing cycle | to another offered cycle, from the next month | — | — |
| credit limit | — | raise (within the ceilings) or lower | never |

## Hypothetical increase

On a program whose largest increase is 25 percent and largest credit limit is 25000.00, a current limit of 18000.00 can be raised at one review by at most 4500.00, to 22500.00, provided the combined credit limit rule leaves room; a current limit of 22000.00 can be raised only to 25000.00, the program's largest credit limit.
